meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service
meta.revisionPolicy: Bank-wise figures are the banks' own returns as the RBI publishes them and are not revised once printed; the Outlook's latest March is provisional and is replaced by the next edition's figure. Mergers are disclosed on the acquirer, never joined.
meta.coverage: Income, expenses and profit of urban co-operative banks, scheduled, non-scheduled and all, each financial year
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 784, the Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks' Outlook, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service (one grid per edition, as on 31 March; a March printed by two editions takes the later edition's figure). Table 2. Each year runs April to March; 'No. of UCBs' is the count the year's figures cover.
